review.notes: All 64 physical pages were machine-scanned: a full code-fence balance scan (one balanced ```txt block; no swallowed headings, tables or images) and a normalized 4-gram containment plus sentence-level PDF-text-versus-OCR diff. The diff exposed a systematic droppage class: every page-bottom footnote body of the main card (1-14) and of both embedded addenda (1-3 each) is missing from the OCR while the inline $^{n}$ markers survive; all 20 bodies were transcribed and inserted after their anchors. Low-containment table pages (6, 8, 16, 35, 44, 47, 52-58) were inspected individually: the dips come from PDF reading order versus transcribed HTML tables and from win-rate figures embedded as images, not from dropped values; Table 4/Table 5, Table 8 and the new addendum benchmark tables match the print. Twelve pages (1, 2, 6, 7, 8, 28, 35, 44, 45, 52, 53, 56) plus table bands on pages 6, 7, 8 and 35 were verified line-by-line against 300-dpi renders. Remaining page-by-page prose comparison of the unflagged pages was machine-scan only (coverage partial). Table 1/2/3 benchmark-name cells glued to their description lines (for example MMLUGeneral reasoning) were left unchanged pending a broader table-structure decision.
